description: Parking - PCNs issued and income by year: 2007 - 2025 is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. Penalty Charge Notices issued and income each year. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Parking and Mobility. Its keywords are Parking, on-street, off-street, Car Parking, Income, Transparency. The portal shows 19 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
